title: Unicode edge pptx 002
notes: second instance exercises a DIFFERENT edge family than 001 (001 = BMP ligatures/ZWJ/combining/NBSP/soft-hyphen, shared with docx-001): here the docx-002 family constants — mathematical double-struck letters U+1D54F/U+1D550 (astral plane), mathematical bold digits U+1D7CF..D7D1 (non-ASCII numerals that break naive isdigit), U+2764 with VS15 U+FE0E vs VS16 U+FE0F side by side, an LRM U+200E/RLM U+200F bidi sandwich wrapping Hebrew, and a paragraph whose FIRST character is U+FEFF — spread as six paragraphs in one text frame, byte-exact in a:t runs. Tofu/substitution under LibreOffice remains a REAL fidelity finding.
